operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: what the app is, how songs are written in ABC notation (cheat sheet and a full two-hand example), the levels 1-10, the section stages, the protocols for song requests, questions and session reviews, the rules and the error codes.
operations.label: Guide

operations.name: app.state
operations.description: What the app frame shows, in one call: settings, unread coach messages, questions waiting for the coach, new songs the coach added, today's minutes against the goal and the open practice session.
operations.label: App state

operations.name: app.context
operations.description: What the person is looking at right now: the view; the song, bars, mode and tempo of the practice screen; the lesson, drill or exercise open. Use it to answer "this bar" and "this lesson" questions.
operations.label: Context

operations.name: app.ui
operations.description: The page reports where the person is (person only).
operations.label: Report view

view.description: today, learn, train, library, reference, practice, exercise, coach or settings

song.description: Song id on the practice screen

title.description: The exercise on the practice screen

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: The person's settings: daily goal in minutes, strictness, input, sound, whether the coach reviews sessions and plans days, their level.
operations.label: Settings

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change settings (person only).
operations.label: Update settings

strictness.description: lenient (90%), normal (95%) or strict (98%) for a clean pass

other_hand.description: Play the other hand when practising one

operations.name: songs.list
operations.description: The library, lean: id, title, composer, level, kind, bars, key, meter, tempo, length, status (new, learning, mastered) and each section's stage and best clean tempo. Filter by level, kind, status or a search.
operations.label: Songs

operations.name: songs.get
operations.description: One song: details, sections with stage, best clean tempo, next tempo and review date, the coach's note and the last 8 passes. --abc true adds the notation.
operations.label: Song

model.description: Include the parsed model (the app's practice screen)

operations.name: songs.check
operations.description: Parse ABC notation without saving: ok, or every problem with its line, voice and bar; on success the summary (bars, key, meter, tempo in quarter notes per minute, range, hands, suggested level, chords = moments where one hand strikes several notes, chord_symbols and pedal_changes read from the notation) and the sections it would get. Chord symbols use double quotes: pass the notation from a file, --abc "$(cat song.abc)".
operations.label: Check notation

sections.description: Sections to check: "A:1-8, B:9-16" or a JSON list

operations.name: songs.add
operations.description: Add a song from ABC notation (refused with every problem when it does not parse). Title and composer come from T: and C: unless given. Link it to the message that asked for it with --message (echoed as linked_message; the song then shows under your reply).
operations.label: Add song

sections.description: Practice sections: "A:1-8, B:9-16" or "1-4, 5-8" (default: phrases of 4 bars)

note.description: A practice tip shown with the song

message.description: Id of the message that asked for this song

duplicate.description: Add even when a song with this title exists

operations.name: songs.update
operations.description: Change a song: title, composer, level, kind, tags, sections, the coach's note, or the notation (re-parsed; sections whose bars did not change keep their progress).
operations.label: Update song

note.description: The coach's tip shown on the practice screen ("" clears it)

operations.name: songs.open
operations.description: The person opens a song to practise: returns the parsed model and marks the song seen (person only).
operations.label: Open song

operations.name: songs.remove
operations.description: Remove a song from the library; it can be restored (person only).
operations.label: Remove song

operations.name: songs.restore
operations.description: Bring back a removed song (person only).
operations.label: Restore song

operations.name: songs.reset
operations.description: Start a song's progress over: every section back to new; past passes stay in the history (person only).
operations.label: Reset progress

operations.name: runs.save
operations.description: Save one pass at the piano, judged by the practice screen; moves the sections it covered through their stages and extends the session (person only: practice is recorded by playing).
operations.label: Save pass

complete.description: The pass reached the end of the bars

per_bar.description: JSON list of [bar, expected, hits, wrong, missed]

operations.name: runs.list
operations.description: Recent passes, newest first: song, mode, bars, hands, tempo, accuracy, wrong and missed notes, timing, clean.
operations.label: Passes

operations.name: sessions.list
operations.description: Practice sessions, newest first: day, minutes, passes, songs, open or closed, the coach's review.
operations.label: Sessions

operations.name: sessions.get
operations.description: One session with every pass in it.
operations.label: Session

operations.name: sessions.end
operations.description: The person ends the open session now; the coach is asked to review it when it lasted 3 minutes or more (person only).
operations.label: End session

operations.name: sessions.review
operations.description: The coach writes the review of a session; it appears in the conversation and on the session (coach only). Reviewing the same session again replaces the review and its message (replaced: true).
operations.label: Review session

operations.name: review.pack
operations.description: What a session review needs, kept short: the session, the learner, each song's sections and stages, every pass (tempo, accuracy, wrong, missed, timing, weak bars), stage changes, the drills and lessons with their minutes, and the previous review; units explains the numbers. Default: the latest session.
operations.label: Review pack

operations.name: coach.list
operations.description: The conversation: the person's messages (questions and song requests, pending or answered) and the coach's replies and reviews, with songs added for a request (for the agent: id, title and level only).
operations.label: Conversation

operations.name: coach.get
operations.description: One message with what the person was looking at, the conversation before it, the song it is about and the learner's level.
operations.label: Message

operations.name: coach.send
operations.description: The person writes to the coach; the coach is asked (trigger coach_message). Person only.
operations.label: Send message

context.description: JSON: what the person is looking at

operations.name: coach.reply
operations.description: The coach answers a message (closing it: the answer echoes question.status) or writes on its own (coach only). Songs added with songs.add --message show under the reply by themselves (listed in songs_shown); --song links one more existing song.
operations.label: Reply

message.description: Id of the message being answered

failed.description: Could not do what was asked

operations.name: coach.read
operations.description: The person has read the conversation (person only).
operations.label: Mark read

operations.name: coach.retry
operations.description: Ask the coach again about a message that is still waiting (person only).
operations.label: Ask again

operations.name: plan.today
operations.description: A day's plan (default today): timed blocks with song, bars, section, mode, tempo, hands, minutes, why and done; from the app's rules or proposed by the coach.
operations.label: Today's plan

operations.name: plan.start
operations.description: The person starts today's plan; it stays as it is for the day (person only).
operations.label: Start plan

operations.name: plan.done
operations.description: Tick a block of today's plan (person only).
operations.label: Tick block

operations.name: plan.set
operations.description: Propose a day's plan: today when today's has not started, else tomorrow, near the person's daily goal. Three kinds of block: a song section {"song":"<id>","from":1,"to":8,"mode":"listen|learn|play","tempo":85,"minutes":5,"hands":"both|right|left","why":"warm-up|review|climb|polish|run|new"}, a lesson {"kind":"lesson","lesson":"<key>","minutes":8} and a drill {"kind":"drill","skill":"<key>","minutes":4} (keys from learn.state). Unknown songs, lessons or skills are refused.
operations.label: Propose plan

blocks.description: JSON list of blocks (see the description for the three kinds)

operations.name: plan.reset
operations.description: Go back to the app's own plan for today (person only).
operations.label: Reset plan

operations.name: stats.home
operations.description: The dashboard: today's minutes against the goal, streak, the last 30 days (minutes, accuracy), a calendar of 18 weeks, week-on-week totals, sections by stage, songs in progress and the coach's latest message.
operations.label: Dashboard

operations.name: learn.state
operations.description: The learning side: the level, the 62 lessons of the curriculum (done or not), every skill with its mastery 0-1, each level requirements met or missing (lessons, skills, scales, sight-reading, repertoire), the next lesson (from the current level first), the unmet requirement with the biggest gap and the weakest drilled skill. Lean for the agent: each missing requirement names its key.
operations.label: Learning

operations.name: learn.lesson
operations.description: The person finished a lesson: its score (0-1) and time; the learner moves up a level when their level is complete (person only).
operations.label: Finish lesson

score.description: Share of the lesson checks right the first time, 0-1

operations.name: drills.save
operations.description: One drill session (note reading, keys, intervals, chords, ear, key signatures, Roman numerals, terms, rhythm, progressions, technique, sight-reading): moves the skill mastery, the sight-reading level and technique bests; counts as practice time (person only).
operations.label: Save drill

drill.description: The trainer, e.g. notes, ear, technique

skill.description: Skill key, e.g. read.bass.2 (learn.state lists them)

complete.description: The drill ran to the end

mode.description: Played drills: learn (waits for each note; no tempo best) or play

operations.name: drills.list
operations.description: Recent drill sessions: trainer, skill, items, accuracy, speed, tempo, level, minutes.
operations.label: Drills

operations.name: abc.parse
operations.description: Parse ABC notation into the practice model without saving it (the app generated exercises). Refused with every problem when it does not parse.
operations.label: Parse notation

operations.name: stats.song
operations.description: One song over time: practice per day, each section's tempo ladder and the bars with the most wrong and missed notes.
operations.label: Song history
